{{Top|leg}}
'''The electrobolt assault rifle''' was a type of [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] in use around the time of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]. They were cheap and reliable, and were powered by an [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]] rather than a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]]. Electrobolt rifles fired bolts of condensed electrical energy and were more useful for jolting and stunning a target into unconsciousness than actually killing them, since they had slightly less firepower. [[Gorog]] warriors of the Dark Nest were armed with them, as well as [[Trident/Legends|tridents]].
